text_simplified: The text contains Qur'anic ayahs and Prophetic ahadith discussing the importance of salah and birr al-walidayn (dutifulness to parents). Experts recommend raising children upon these values from a young age. Parents can reinforce positive behavior through good role modeling.

review_defects.why: The Arabic term 'تربية' is transliterated as 'Tarbiyah' in the title but translated as 'raising' in the body text ('raising children'), creating inconsistent treatment of the same term within the same document.
